selection: Six XL330-M288-T and six XC330-M288-T; joint assignments are in board/mechanical/prototype/joints.json

mode.name: current_based_position
mode.note: Physical-unit effective servo gains, not ROBOTIS register gain identification. Host must enforce position limits in mode 5.

assumptions.source: Engineering sensitivity scenarios; not manufacturer bounds or measured confidence intervals

limitations: Stall endpoints describe brief output and are not continuous ratings.
Equivalent resistance, back EMF and gearbox efficiency are fitted to endpoints; no-load motor current and internal winding/driver loss split are unknown.
The published 17 mA is electronics standby, not no-load motor current.
Backlash is approximated as position deadband; tooth impacts and two-inertia transmission are not modeled.
Thermal scenarios are a lumped effective case model and do not bound winding hot spots or certify continuous duty.
Supply can absorb negative DC power in the analysis; actual regeneration handling remains a circuit design requirement.
